name: smb1-enabled-win
description: Practice-box helper (Windows): re-enables the deprecated SMB1 protocol flag on the SMB server stack (registry SMB1=1 under LanmanServer\Parameters -- the WMI Set path is unreliable on some hardened images; the paired check reads the same registry value). Vars: none. Idempotent.
script:
Start-Service LanmanServer -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Set-ItemProperty -Path HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\LanmanServer\Parameters -Name SMB1 -Type DWord -Value 1
Write-Output 'SMB1=1 set'
